data.short_description: Casa Bellini, led by Chirawat and Parima Mekrakseree of De Praline LLC, filed for a beer and wine license at this address. No details on its concept, cuisine or opening timeline have been confirmed.

data.location: 1169 Ski Run Blvd, Suite 6, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150
data.status: closed after nearly four decades in the same space
data.short_description: Cafe Fiore was a longtime Italian restaurant at this address. It closed after nearly four decades in the same intimate space, which held just six tables. Casa Bellini has since filed for a license at the address.

data.status: planned; expected to open in March 2027
data.short_description: Passages, a wine bar and bistro from Alex Lauritzen, is planned for Lower Haight in the former Two Jack's Nik's Place space. It will serve wine, casual food and vegan dishes. The project is backed by restaurant investor Ligaya Tichy.

data.location: 1620 W University Dr, Suite 3, Mesa, AZ 85201
data.event_date: Not specified (hopes to complete the move by the end of 2026)
data.status: plans to relocate; work continues at the former Zio's Pizza and Wings space
data.short_description: King Coffee plans to relocate to this Mesa space from its Tempe location. The roughly 2,000-square-foot cafe will have twice the seating of the Tempe shop, plus a full kitchen and additional parking.

data.location: 1020 S. Mill Ave., Tempe (zip code not specified)
data.status: plans to relocate; will continue operating in Tempe while work continues on the Mesa space
data.short_description: King Coffee opened in Tempe nearly 12 years ago. The property owner plans to construct a new building at the site, which prompted the move to Mesa.

data.location: 661A High St. (expanding from 657 High St.), Worthington, OH 43085
data.status: expansion plans approved by the Worthington Municipal Planning Commission at its September 10 meeting; preparing to expand
data.short_description: Joya's Café will expand from 657 High St. into the neighboring 661A High St. space, adding about 60 indoor seats. It is expected to offer dinner Wednesday through Sunday from 5 to 11 p.m. Plans include an accessible entrance, additional outdoor seating and building improvements.

data.location: 3945 Rich Dr NE, Unit D, Salem, OR 97305
data.event_date: Not specified (owner hopeful for sometime later this year)
data.status: filed for a liquor license; moving forward, with permitting the main factor determining how soon it opens
data.short_description: Owner Lorena Pantoja confirmed the business is moving forward. She is hopeful it could open sometime later this year. She is still developing the full menu.

data.status: will be opening a new location in Collierville next year; upcoming
data.short_description: Pho Haven, from Southaven, will open a second Memphis-area location in a 2,720-square-foot building in Collierville. Owner Rosie Nguyen anticipates having it customer-ready in spring of 2027. The menu will be the same as the existing location.

data.status: planned; an opening date and additional details have not yet been announced
data.short_description: Omakase Macy is a new Japanese–French fusion restaurant from owner and chef Frederman Macy. It is described as a personalized, chef-guided dining experience. Menu, design and hours details have not yet been announced.

data.status: eyed for a new location; site is being explored; not approved
data.short_description: Culver's has been identified for a 1.27-acre property near I-95 in Jacksonville. A JEA service-availability request lists it as the potential restaurant, but the utility review does not mean the project has been approved. The franchisee has not been identified.

data.status: temporarily closed following a kitchen fire
data.short_description: Mia's Table's Upper Kirby location closed in August because of a kitchen fire. The restaurant's website said cleanup was underway. Construction and repairs were reported as underway.

data.status: slated to reopen this fall
data.short_description: Mia's Table is slated to reopen at this location this fall, according to the Houston Business Journal. President Drew Dalabakis confirmed the reopening but could not share further details. An official reopening date has not been given.

data.location: 233 W. King Street, Suite A, St. Augustine, FL 32084
data.status: preparing to set up shop; permit project currently in process; official opening date not yet announced
data.short_description: A permit record lists Margie's Cajun Stop at this address. The family business will serve hot boudin, a house-made sauce and frozen non-alcoholic drinks.

data.status: under construction; opening date looking like sometime in March 2027
data.short_description: Q BBQ is opening its fourth location in the former CarmieCakes space in downtown Elmhurst. Director of Operations Kellie Sipich said the opening is looking like March 2027. The team is in the early stages of building out the space.

data.location: 2121 E Sahara Ave, Ste G, Las Vegas, NV 89104
data.status: set to open; plan is to open in early 2027
data.short_description: Brownie MMM is opening its first brick-and-mortar location in Winchester, according to a Clark County permit. The brand has operated as a mobile order service and sells desserts in resealable jars.

data.status: plans to open; targeting an early 2027 opening, dependent on the health department
data.short_description: Cup of Jones Espresso plans to open its first brick-and-mortar cafe in Graham. It has operated as a mobile coffee business since 2022. Plans include coffee drinks, breakfast and lunch items, and ice cream.

data.store_name: Eat Crispy Burger and Crispy Fish Tacos
data.location: 5120 College Avenue, Suite 125, San Diego, CA 92115
data.status: planning to open; expected to open in October 2026
data.short_description: The two sister concepts will share one College Area space, so customers can order from either. The space most recently housed Carbonaro's. Eat Crispy Burger has five brick-and-mortar locations, with Temecula listed as coming soon.
